method.request_model: closed loop, one in-flight SQL per independent Quack connection
method.python_client_limits: threads=1, memory_limit=32MB per independent client instance; client and driver CPU sampled together
method.transport: Quack loopback; direct fs HTTP and RustFS S3 without Python proxies
method.storage: Caller-supplied TiDB and RustFS binaries, all services on this host; record backing TiKV topology separately
method.cache: warm DuckDB buffer pool for matrix; fresh workers with 64MB buffer pool for stream; OS/object caches not purged
method.timing: client end-to-end SQL through durable COMMIT acknowledgement; process creation/attach/checkpoint excluded and checkpoint measured separately
method.order: same-configuration trials adjacent; rotate first backend each trial/configuration
method.latency_quantiles: linear interpolation of all successful request latencies per run; raw samples saved; low N cannot establish stable p99
